title: A flickered unit token keeps its size
notes: R444, R175: a unit token Flickered keeps the X/X it was summoned at (and the Bread Token's Armor), as one a Reborn brings back does, where the reset had made it a printed 0/0 that died at once: under a Radiant Shadowstep it flickered again and the board never settled. R57: Radiant Shadowstep's copies of the units it flickers are made with copyOf, so a copy of a token carries the X/X and Armor too, and add_to_hand's copyOf carries a Bread Token's Armor (summon's copy already did). The classifier's unforced games show The Rock (core-066) playing differently; the Bread Token and Shadowstep are the cards the rule is about, and a forced game of Shadowstep alone shows no divergence.

player.title: Flickered tokens keep their size
fixes: A token summoned at a size (the Bread Token's 5/5 and its Armor) keeps it when it is Flickered, instead of coming back as a 0/0 that dies at once.
Radiant Shadowstep's copies of a flickered token carry its size and Armor too.
